text:
Boston Meetup Update ❤️

Unfortunately, we have to cancel the Boston Shih Tzu Meetup on September 13th. We’re so sorry to disappoint everyone who was looking forward to getting together with all of their Shih Tzus. 🐶💔

We truly appreciate everyone who planned to attend and all of the love and support you’ve shown for the meetup.

We hope to see you and your pups at the NYC Shih Tzu Meetup on October 11th! 🐾❤️
